# rex — Zero-config universal project runner

## What is rex?
rex is a CLI tool that detects your project type and runs the correct command automatically. No configuration needed.

## Install
go install rexrun.dev/rex/cmd/rex@latest

## Usage
- `rex test` — runs tests (detects go test, pnpm test, cargo test, pytest, etc.)
- `rex run` — starts the app or dev server
- `rex build` — builds the project
- `rex deps` — installs dependencies
- `rex clean` — removes build artifacts
- `rex fresh` — clean + deps + build
- `rex fmt` — formats code
- `rex lint` — lints code
- `rex doctor` — diagnoses environment issues

## Supported stacks
Go, Node.js (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun), Python (pip/uv/poetry), Rust, Java (Maven/Gradle), Docker, Makefile, Justfile

## How it works
rex reads files in your project root (go.mod, package.json, Cargo.toml, etc.) and maps verbs to the correct commands. It detects package managers by checking lockfiles.
